observations: Three black rectangular boxes are stacked in two rows, each with a PlayStation logo on the front.
The boxes appear to be PS4 console boxes, with the 'PS4' label visible vertically on the right edge of the rightmost box in photo 2.
The boxes are dusty and show signs of wear, including smudges and minor scratches.
The background shows a retail store with shelves of games and electronics, and a watermark 'ANO KING GAMES STORE' is overlaid on all photos.
